{{Quote|Oh-Seven: the fiercest hunter of all your brothers.|Taun We, regarding RC-1207|<ref name="RepCom" />}}
'''Sev''', also known by the designations '''RC-1207''' and '''Delta-07''', was a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. Born in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] on the [[Water/Legends|watery]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], Sev was trained by the Mandalorian ''[[Cuy'val Dar]]'' training [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] [[Walon Vau]] to become a [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Joining with three other [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] to form the elite [[Special forces/Legends|special forces]] unit [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]], Sev served as the unit's star [[Clone sharpshooter/Legends|sniper]]. When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|broke out]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Sev took his place in the Grand Army's [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]] under [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Arligan Zey]] and served alongside his clone brothers in [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]] on a number of battlefields, ranging from the [[Desert/Legends|deserts]] of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], [[Mission to the Chaykin Cluster|the halls]] of the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|RAS]] ''[[Prosecutor]]'', and [[Mission to Coruscant (Clone Wars)|the streets]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], to snowy [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]] and [[Battle of Haurgab|the plains]] of [[Haurgab]]. Known for his morbid sense of humor and a hatred of [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]], Sev was an efficient [[Death/Legends|killer]] and loyal [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] who completed several covert operations within Delta Squad until the squad's fateful [[Mission to Kashyyyk (Clone Wars)|mission]] to [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. There, while in the process of destroying a [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist]] [[Warship/Legends|warship]] over the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]], Sev fell under attack, and the other members of Delta Squad were ordered to pull out of the area without him, forced to leave Sev behind. With the rest of his squad unsure whether he was alive or dead, Sev became one of many clone soldiers listed as missing in action.

==Biography==
===Early life and training===
{{Quote|RC-1207 continues to excel in sniper and ambush training. However, please re-check DNA for possible mental aberration.|RC Batch Delta: Report: W Vau, Training Sergeant|<ref name="RepCom" />}}
[[File:SevOnKamino.png|thumb|left|170px|Sev on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]]]
RC-1207 was born in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], in the [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] [[Clone military education complex|facilities]] of [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]], on the [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. A clone of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] created to serve in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] as a [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]], RC-1207 took the name "Sev" for himself,<ref name="RepCom" /> the name originating from the last digit of his numerical designation,<ref name="O66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref> and was placed under the training of the Mandalorian ''[[Cuy'val Dar]]'' training [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]], [[Walon Vau]].<ref name="RepCom" /> Vau believed in training his clones hard, giving them his worst in training so that they could perform to their best once out in the field—to do anything less would compromise them. Though there were those who believed that Vau's methods were too brutal, Sev was grateful to Vau for making him and his clone brethren into survivors. Sev looked up to Vau, and had a desperate desire not to ever let his training sergeant down. As a result, Sev would push himself to the point of daily exhaustion, often collapsing into his bunk at the end of each day of training.<ref name="TZ">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]''</ref>

Sev was assigned to [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]], one of the first commando units established by the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]], along with, [[RC-1140/Legends|RC-1140]] "Fixer," and [[Scorch/Legends|Scorch]], and under the command of [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] [[Boss (clone commando)/Legends|Boss]].<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> As his training progressed, Sev stood out in ambush training and quickly displayed his skill as a [[Clone sharpshooter/Legends|sniper]]; the Kaminoan project coordinator for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] clone [[Army/Legends|army]], [[Taun We/Legends|Taun We]], regarded Sev as a fierce hunter.<ref name="RepCom" />

===Geonosis===
{{Quote|Getting acquainted with the locals, eh, Sev?''"<br />"That was fun.|Boss and Sev, after Sev ambushed and killed a Geonosian|<ref name="RepCom" />}}
The Grand Army finally saw action in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], when [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] took the army to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] to rescue [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> Sev and the rest of Delta Squad were sent to Geonosis in a deployment so hastily ordered and carried out that it left Delta with no time to say goodbye to their training sergeant, Vau.<ref name="TZ" /> Delta Squad was tasked with [[Assassin/Legends|assassinating]] [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser's]] chief [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]], [[Sun Fac/Legends|Sun Fac]]. The four commandos split up, each boarding a single [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] independently, with the intention of rendezvousing once on the surface of Geonosis.<ref name="RepCom" /> Once on the ground, Sev was the first member of Delta to reach the appointed rendezvous and was soon joined by his squadmates. Reunited, Delta Squad attacked Sun Fac in his command center, although the Geonosian leader managed to flee and escape. Delta tracked Fac through the [[Geonosian catacombs/Legends|Geonosian catacombs]], eventually catching up with him in Fac's private [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] as the Geonosian attempted to escape in [[Nantex-class territorial defense starfighter/Legends|his starfighter]]. However, Fac's escape was prevented by the timely actions of Sev, who used the [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniping]] attachment of his [[DC-17m Interchangeable Weapon System/Legends|DC-17m]] [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] to shoot down the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], [[Death/Legends|killing]] Fac. Sev was also the first of the Deltas to spot the [[Soulless One/Legends|personal starfighter]] of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] as it departed Geonosis, though none of the commandos were able to recognize it for what it was at the time.<ref name="RepCom" /> Sev and the other members of Delta Squad were then tasked by [[Advisor/Legends|clone advisor]] [[01/425]] to complete the failed objective of their fellow Republic commando squad [[Theta Squad]]: destroying an underground [[Geonosis droid factories/Legends|droid factory]]. The commandos infiltrated the factory and targeted weak points in the facility's design, together causing enough damage to destroy it.<ref name="RepCom" />

[[File:DeltaSquad_RCcover.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Sev with Boss and Scorch]]
A year after the destruction of the droid factory, Delta Squad was given new orders, tasked with the infiltration of a [[Core ship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class Core Ship]]. Deployed in a nearby canyon from an LAAT/i gunship [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by [[Clone trooper pilot|clone pilot]] [[Delta 42]], Delta Squad made their way to the Core Ship, using a downed gunship's [[Composite-beam laser|composite-beam]] turrets to fend off enemy Geonosians along the way. As they continued toward the Core Ship, the squad was called upon to take out an [[Anti-aircraft cannon/Legends|anti-aircraft cannon]]. Sev and the other commandos fought through a number of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] and their [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|super battle droid]] counterparts, before finally destroying the large anti-aircraft emplacement. When the squad finally reached the Core Ship, they were met with resistance from an [[A-DSD advanced dwarf spider droid|advanced spider droid]], and a [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shield]] blocking the ship's entrance. The four commandos were able to destroy the spider droid with considerable effort, and they then called in air support to blow through the ray-shielded entrance.<ref name="RepCom" /> Once inside, Delta Squad again split up, each of its members sabotaging and destroying various crucial systems; Sev infiltrated the [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] control room, and [[Slicer/Legends|sliced]] into the system, shutting down all repulsors and jarring the ship. When Scorch and Fixer came under heavy fire from a small number of [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]], Sev met up with Boss to rescue them, with Sev even leaping on an unshielded droideka while it rolled by, finishing it off with his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. Their primary objective, however, was the capture of vital launch codes housed on the ship's [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]]. Once on the bridge, Delta came under heavy fire from numerous battle droids and stationary [[Autoturret/Legends|autoturrets]], but still managed to acquire the codes before retreating down a branching corridor. By this time, the squad's efforts to sabotage the Core Ship had come to full fruition, with several primary systems overloading. With no time to make an escape back the way they had come, Delta Squad was extracted via LAAT/i gunship through a hole forcefully blown in the [[Hull/Legends|hull]] of the ship.<ref name="RepCom" />

The [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]] was the first action Sev and his brothers from Delta Squad saw, but with the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] breaking out throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] between the Galactic Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], it would not be the last. Delta Squad would prove to be one of the lucky minority of Republic commando squads to depart Geonosis intact and with no casualties; 4,982 other commandos perished on Geonosis' [[Color/Legends|red]] sands. The death of these nearly five thousand clones influenced Sev's lasting hatred of Geonosians, and throughout the Clone Wars, Sev would attempt to kill 4,982 Geonosians in vengeance for the commando losses that day.<ref name="O66" />

===Mission to the ''Prosecutor''===
{{Dialogue|Advisor 01/425|We're sending our most qualified squad to investigate. Someone important noted your excellence on Geonosis.|Scorch|You hear that, Sev? Someone thinks ''I'm'' excellent.|Sev|Well...at least that makes ''two'' of you.|attr=Prior to the mission to the ''Prosecutor''|src=<ref name="RepCom" />}}
[[File:RC-1207_Sev.jpg|thumb|left|225px|Sev in his distinctly decorated armor with his favored DC-17m sniper rifle]]
On the day before the second anniversary of the Battle of Geonosis, three hundred and sixty-seven days into the Clone Wars, Sev and the rest of Delta Squad were called upon to [[Mission to the Chaykin Cluster|investigate]] the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] ''[[Prosecutor]]''. Having recently reappeared in the [[Chaykin Cluster]] following a two-[[Standard week/Legends|week]]-long disappearance while tasked with defending [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade routes]] in the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]], the ''Prosecutor'' was found drifting, without power or communication capability. Delta Squad had spent a substantial amount of time aboard the [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] during the early portion of the war, even coming to think of it as their "first home." Arriving on scene in the [[Corbantis system/Legends|Corbantis system]] aboard a [[CR25 troop carrier/Legends|CR25 troop carrier]], Delta Squad was tasked with retrieving flight records from the ''Prosecutor''{{'s}} four [[Datacore/Legends|data cores]] and securing the derelict [[Assault ship/Legends|assault ship]]; Sev was charged with acquiring the data from the ship's starboard data core.<ref name="RepCom" />

The four members of Delta Squad disembarked from the CR25 via a jump through the [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]] of [[Realspace/Legends|space]], splitting up and entering the ''Prosecutor'' at four different locations. Interference in their [[Comm unit/Legends|comms]] quickly cut Sev and the others off from the guidance of 01/425, who was again serving as mission advisor to the squad. While searching the ship, Delta Squad came across few survivors, and several members were set upon by [[Salvage droid/Legends|scavenger droids]]; Scorch was ambushed and incapacitated by the [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. Shortly after, the squad found that the ''Prosecutor'' has been attacked by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] and [[Trandoshan Elites|mercenaries]] when Sev was captured at the starboard data core. He was beaten and interrogated by the Trandoshans before Boss and Fixer were able to battle their way through heavily armed and [[Armor/Legends|armored]] Trandoshan [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] to rescue Sev. Once Sev was free of the violent interrogation from his Trandoshan captors, the still incomplete squad moved to retrieve Scorch from where he was being held in the ''Prosecutor''{{'s}} [[detention area]]. After a brief skirmish in the detention area, Delta Squad located and revived an incapacitated Scorch, and together made their way to the bridge, where they destroyed a Confederacy [[Jammer/Legends|jamming device]] and re-established communication with their advisor.<ref name="RepCom" />

A brief [[Scanner|scan]] revealed that a [[Trandoshan dropship]] had touched down in one of the ''Prosecutor''{{'s}} hangar bays. Proceeding to the hangar—after being sidetracked through the detention center by a booby-trapped [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]]—Sev and the other members of Delta Squad found that a [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class battleship]] had entered the [[Star system/Legends|system]] and was rapidly approaching the ''Prosecutor''. While their advisor called for assistance, Delta Squad was charged with repelling the [[Battle droid dispenser|droid]] [[B2 battle droid dispenser|boarding]] [[Droideka dispenser|parties]] and sealing the assault ship's hangars. By the time Sev and the others reached the final hangar, it was overrun with droids, and the commandos had to resort to commandeering the roof-mounted [[Mass-driver cannon/Legends|mass-driver cannon]] of an [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE]] [[Walker/Legends|walker]] to deal with the droid threat. Following these losses, the Separatist [[Battleship/Legends|battleship]] opened fire on the ''Prosecutor'', deciding to cut its losses and destroy the Republic [[Warship/Legends|warship]] before reinforcements could arrive. In an attempt to hold off the battleship, Delta Squad struggled to get the ''Prosecutor''{{'s}} turbolaser battery array back online amidst a continuing assault from droid forces already onboard. Reinforcements came in the form of [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Talbot]] and the RAS [[Arrestor (Acclamator-class)|''Arrestor'']], the only Republic force to respond to 01/425's calls for assistance. Between the combined strength of the ''Arrestor'' and ''Prosecutor''—even as the latter's hull integrity was compromised—the Confederacy [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|droid control ship]] was destroyed, shutting down the battle droids aboard the ''Prosecutor'', and saving the ship and the lives of Delta Squad. Sev and his Delta Squad brothers were commended by [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] for their actions aboard the ''Prosecutor'', and the data that they retrieved would help enable the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] to better combat Trandoshan slaving operations in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]].<ref name="RepCom" />

===Work with Omega Squad===
{{Dialogue|Darman|I want my HUD back. I want my enhanced view.|Fi|But you get to wear face camo instead. Makes you feel wild and dangerous.|Sev|I'm wild. And then I get dangerous. ''Shut up''.|Scorch|Don't mind him. He'll be fine once he's killed something.|attr=[[Darman Skirata|Darman]], [[Fi Skirata|Fi]], Sev and Scorch on Coruscant|src=<ref name="TZ" />}}
Sev and the rest of Delta Squad departed the ''Prosecutor'' aboard a captured [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]]. Shortly thereafter, they received a [[Red Zero]] signal—the GAR code requesting immediate extraction—from their fellow commando unit [[Omega Squad]]. Delta Squad was the closest Republic unit to Omega's position aboard a [[Gizer L-6 freighter|damaged]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] at the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian]]&ndash;[[Perlemian node|Perlemian]] [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] intersection, in the [[Tynna sector/Legends|Tynna sector]], and the first on site to recover both their commando comrades and [[M'truli|the trio]] [[Gysk|of]] [[Farr Orjul|prisoners]] Omega Squad had [[Mission to the Corellian-Perlemian Intersection|apprehended]]. Once safely on board, Sev nearly provoked a physical confrontation with Omega Squad member [[Atin Skirata|Atin]]; Atin had been a trainee of Walon Vau back on Kamino, the same as Sev and the other Deltas, though Atin had sworn to kill Vau for the brutality that he had suffered during training and after returning from the Battle of Geonosis as the sole survivor of his [[Unidentified clone commando squad (Atin)|original squad]]. Omega Squad's sergeant, [[Niner Skirata|Niner]], was able to keep the conflict from turning violent, although Sev remained ill-at-ease with Atin. Both Delta and Omega Squad docked aboard the ''Acclamator''-class ship ''[[Fearless]]'' and returned to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="TZ" />

[[File:RC-1207.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Sev waiting in the shadows with his DC-17m sniper rifle at the ready]]
On Coruscant, Sev and the other Delta Squad members were recruited by the former ''Cuy'val Dar'' sergeant [[Kal Skirata]] for a [[Mission to Coruscant (Clone Wars)|black ops mission]] to be conducted on Coruscant itself. In the days and weeks prior, Coruscant had suffered a number of [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] attacks on [[Depot Bravo Five|GAR facilities]], and Skirata had devised a means of covertly striking back at the terrorists culprits. Together with Omega Squad, Delta's former trainer Walon Vau, the [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando]]s [[Ordo Skirata|Ordo]] and [[Mereel Skirata|Mereel]], and Jedi Generals [[Bardan Jusik]] and [[Etain Tur-Mukan]], Sev and the rest of Delta Squad began an investigation into the terrorists' whereabouts from the seedy [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]-owned [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] [[Qibbu's Hut/Legends|Qibbu's Hut]], in Coruscant's [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Entertainment District]]. Though Sev's grudge against Atin remained, and even grew to include Atin's squadmate [[Fi Skirata|Fi]]—whose talkative and jovial nature grated on Sev, and who had rallied to Atin during his initial confrontation with Sev—the two squads grew to respect each other, and Sev was able to lay his grudge with Atin to rest. Using [[Qibbu]] the Hutt's criminal contacts, the counter-terrorist strike team was able to lure their targets under the pretense of having a supply of high-yield thermal [[Plastoid/Legends|plastoid]] explosive that they were willing to sell. While Skirata acted as the strike team's public face, meeting with members of the terror cell—including its leader, [[Perrive]]—Sev and Scorch teamed with Omega Squad's [[Darman Skirata|Darman]] and Fi to mark the terrorists with [[Dust|specially designed tracers]] using Skirata's personally owned [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] [[Verpine shatter gun|sniper rifles]]. Later, while performing reconnaissance on the marked terrorists—now identified as [[Homeworld/Legends|hailing]] from [[Jabiim/Legends|Jabiim]] via their accents—Sev dislocated his shoulder while attempting to outperform Fi. Fortunately, Fi was a trained [[Medic/Legends|medic]] and was able to put the joint back into its socket, and Sev was able to continue operating. After a meeting between Skirata and the terrorist leader Perrive establishing a time when they would supposedly make the explosives sale, Delta Squad spent an evening enjoying themselves at Qibbu's bar with the other members of the strike team, at least until the revelry was cut short by a call from Perrive stating they would need to move up their time and change the pre-established location. Fortunately, the new location for the trade was a [[CoruFresh]] produce distribution depot in [[Quadrant F-76]] of [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]], a location Delta Squad had personally reconnoitered earlier.<ref name="TZ" />

Sev partnered with Ordo, Fixer and Atin on the depot's roof, awaiting Skirata and Jusik's signal once they had finished making the fake trade of illegal goods. When the signal came, Sev and every other member of the strike team launched their full assault, killing every member of the terrorist cell present and securing the explosives. Once the terrorists were dead, Sev and the others returned to Qibbu's for a final night, and then attended an evening as guests of the [[Coruscant Security Force Staff and Social Club|CSF Social Club]]. But just six days later, Delta Squad was back on assignment, shipped off to [[Skuumaa]] and tasked with battlefield preparation consisting of sabotaging strategic targets ahead of the main Republic assault.<ref name="TZ" />

===Mission to Devaron===
[[File:DeltaSquad-WOTM.png|thumb|left|250px|Delta Squad returns from Devaron]]
{{Quote|There were no survivors on Devaron. Everyone was killed, including Master Halsey and his Padawan.|Boss, reporting on the fate of Halsey|<ref name="WotM">{{TCW|Witches of the Mist}}</ref>}}
Sev and the clone commandos of Delta Squad were later dispatched to Devaron to search for survivors of the engagement with [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]]. Finding none, they recovered the corpses of Jedi Master [[Halsey/Legends|Halsey]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Knox/Legends|Knox]], returning both to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on Coruscant. The [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] concluded that the deaths of the [[Roonan/Legends|Roonan]] Jedi and his apprentice were a sign of a new threat to the Republic; their suspicion was confirmed when security footage of the massacre, including Halsey's death, was recovered.<ref name="WotM" />

===Mygeeto===
{{Quote|Hey, our sarge is ''missing''. Vau could be ''dead'', and you can eat and joke? We ''abandoned'' him. We left him to die. We ''never'' leave a man behind, guys.''"<br />"''Take it easy, Sev. We're all worried.|Sev and Fixer, after leaving Sergeant Vau behind on Mygeeto|<ref name="TC">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref>}}
Four hundred and seventy days after Geonosis, Delta Squad had been sent to the Outer Rim world of [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]]. The squad was tasked with calling in air strikes and sabotaging Mygeetan ground defenses near the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Jygat]] in preparation for [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Bacara/Legends|Bacara]] and the [[Galactic Marines/Legends|Galactic Marines']] [[Battle of Mygeeto|main assault]]. Delta completed their assignments as ordered, but instead of exfiltrating as they were supposed to, Sev and the other commandos instead decided to assist their former training sergeant Vau in his personal mission, one that consisted of robbing Mygeeto's own [[Dressian Kiolsh Merchant Bank]]. Sev followed Vau into the underground halls of the [[Bank/Legends|bank]] with Boss and Scorch, while Fixer kept a look out from their snowspeeder on the surface.<ref name="TC" />

[[File:Delta_Squad1.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Sev, with the other members of Delta Squad]]
Vau successfully infiltrated the [[Safe|vault]], though once inside, he refused to allow the squad to assist him any further in the heist, determined not to compromise his trainees' integrity by directly involving them in the actual act of stealing. It was during Vau's raid on the vault's numerous safety deposit boxes that Sev learned of his former training sergeant's past as a disinherited [[Count of Gesl|aristocrat]] from [[Irmenu]], and that the purpose of the theft was to regain the inheritance his [[Walon Vau's mother|mother]] and [[Walon Vau's father|father]] had denied him. When Vau ordered Delta to leave him and continue with their assigned mission, however, the squad refused—reminding Vau that he was no longer a sergeant, just a civilian—and instead helped Vau and his [[Strill/Legends|strill]], [[Lord Mirdalan]], carry the stolen loot out of the bank.<ref name="TC" />

Their exit became complicated when one of the bank's alarms was triggered, and although Fixer brought the snowspeeder closer to the extraction point, Delta and Vau had to fight their way through an armed patrol of [[Muun/Legends|Muuns]] and battle droids to escape. During the skirmish, Vau fell through a hole in the ice and into one of the countless [[Whiteworm/Legends|crystal-worm]] tunnels that ran beneath the frozen surface of Mygeeto; although Delta Squad was determined to retrieve him, Vau forcefully commanded them to leave him and get themselves to safety. Despite severe reservations, Delta Squad did as ordered and exfiltrated from Mygeeto, although each would have some difficulty coming to terms with their perceived abandonment of their former sergeant, none more so than Sev. However, Boss contacted Kal Skirata and Null [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] Ordo once they were off planet to inform them of Vau's situation; Skirata and Ordo immediately traveled to Mygeeto and managed to extract a [[Hypothermia/Legends|hypothermic]] but still alive Vau from beneath the Mygeetan ice. Sev still looked upon the incident as a personal failure, believing he let his old sergeant down, and swearing to never leave another comrade behind.<ref name="TC" />

===The hunt for Ko Sai===
{{Quote|Wow, this is amazing. Look at ''that!"<br />"''It's a fish, Scorch. You'll get over it. So will the fish.''"<br />"''Come on, how many folks get to do this? Savor the privilege, man.''"<br />"''I will, next time I'm getting my ''shebs'' shot off.|Scorch and Sev, during their first underwater experience in a real ocean|<ref name="TC" />}}
Upon their return to Coruscant from Mygeeto, Delta Squad was debriefed by the [[Director of Special Forces]], Jedi General Arligan Zey, at [[Special Operations Brigade Headquarters]]. Zey then informed Delta of their newest orders: [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] had ordered the capture of the rogue [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]], Kamino's own former [[Chief Scientist/Legends|Chief Scientist]] [[Ko Sai/Legends|Ko Sai]]. Considering her capture as near a priority as locating the Confederacy's [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander]], General Grievous—if only to deny her expertise to the Separatists, but primarily to have an [[Clone Master/Legends|experienced cloner]] unassociated with Tipoca under Republic control—Palpatine insisted that Zey put his most qualified squad on the assignment, from which Zey selected Delta Squad for the task. Ko Sai had gone missing during the [[First Battle of Kamino|Battle of Kamino]], and was suspected to have [[Desertion|defected]] to the Confederacy by Kamino's [[Prime Minister (Kamino)|Prime Minister]], [[Lama Su/Legends|Lama Su]]. Despite the length of time between her disappearance and Delta Squad's tasking of her retrieval, Kaminoan intelligence was able to track Ko Sai's movements to the planet [[Vaynai/Legends|Vaynai]]. Zey insisted that Delta Squad not inform Kal Skirata of their assignment, knowing of the Mandalorian's extreme hate for Kaminoans. Unknown to Delta, Skirata was also already hunting for Ko Sai, but for his own reasons: he wished to use the Kaminoan scientist to find a way to halt the accelerated aging that plagued the Grand Army's millions of clones.<ref name="TC" />

[[File:Delta_Squad.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Sev and Delta Squad in the heat of battle]]
Delta Squad followed the Kaminoans' intelligence reports to Vaynai, and then on to [[Aquaris/Legends|Aquaris]], and from there to [[Napdu]], the fourth [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the planet [[Da Soocha]], in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. During this time, Boss was also battling a [[Cold/Legends|cold]]; his repetitive cough and clearing of his sore throat over the shared [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] in the Delta's helmets annoyed Sev until he insisted Boss take care of the issue. Files acquired from the [[Nar Hej Shipping Company]] on Napdu helped Delta to further trace a pattern of movement for Ko Sai, tracking her across the Outer Rim's numerous aquatic worlds toward the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]]. The squad came under attack from a [[Crusher-class starfighter|''Crusher''-class starfighter]] while leaving Napdu in one of the Grand Army's [[Traffic Interdiction Vessel|TIV]] vessels. They touched down on Da Soocha's [[Da Soocha III|third moon]], with the ''Crusher'' continuing pursuit; on the ground, Boss used the TIV's [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] to blast away one of the ''Crusher''{{'s}} wings, and both Scorch and Sev attacked the wrecked starfighter. During the action, Sev killed the female pilot and her male copilot to Boss's annoyance—dead, they couldn't be interrogated. However, Fixer was able to access the ship's computer and determine that the pair were bounty hunters hired by the Kaminoans to track Ko Sai.<ref name="TC" />

Using the data acquired from the Nar Hej Shipping Company, Delta Squad tracked down the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Leb Chura]] on [[Bogg 4]]. Sev caught the panicked pilot after a brief chase in [[Kerif City]], and the Deltas interrogated Chura as to Ko Sai's whereabouts with the assistance of General Bardan Jusik. Chura had been moving cloning materials from [[Arkania/Legends|Arkania]] to [[Dorumaa]], but the Twi'lek had already relayed this information to Skirata and Vau. In order to keep Skirata and his quest a secret, Jusik [[Mind trick/Legends|influenced]] Chura to recall Mandalorians wearing [[Color/Legends|green]] armor instead of Skirata and Vau's more recognizable [[Gold/Legends|golden]] and black sets when asked, and upon learning that Chura had delivered the consignment to a location near Dorumaa's [[Tropix Island Resort]], Jusik [[Memory rub/Legends|erased]] the pilot's memory of both Delta and Skirata's band, along with deleting the records on his [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]]. Sev noticed Jusik's odd behavior, and commented on it privately with the squad, but chalked it up to Jedi eccentricities. In spite of this, Delta acquired [[Clone SCUBA trooper/Legends|SCUBA trooper]] armor and traveled to the [[Tropix Resorts|resort]] world of Dorumaa. There, Delta acted as part of a utilities maintenance crew in order to gather surveillance which led them to a collapsed area underneath Tropix's neighboring [[ActionWorld]] island. Upon investigating, the squad found the [[Skeleton/Legends|skeletal]] remains of a dead human that had been [[Chain (droid)|chained]] beneath the water, and the collapsed entrance to the facility that had previously belonged to Ko Sai. Skirata and his crew had arrived first, capturing the Kaminoan scientist, destroying the [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]], and taking her back to [[Kyrimorut/Legends|Skirata's home]] on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. The squad was tasked with the slow excavation of the area; at one point they were able to insert a small [[strip-cam]] through an available opening, finding the armored remains of the Mandalorian bodyguards Ko Sai had hired.<ref name="TC" />

Though Delta found no further evidence over the next few weeks of excavation, they remained unyieldingly loyal in covering for General Jusik's absence while the Jedi Knight secretly sneaked away to aid Skirata. Five hundred and forty-eight days into the Clone Wars, the commandos of Delta Squad were called back to Special Operations Brigade on Coruscant, where they were met by Kal Skirata. There, Skirata gave Sev a package containing Ko Sai's severed head; the rogue Kaminoan had taken her own life while being held on Mandalore, and was cut into pieces post-mortem. Sev then delivered Ko Sai's head to General Zey for confirmation of death, neglecting the details of how it had come into Delta's possession while still telling Zey as much of the truth as he knew using tightly wound word games.<ref name="TC" />

===Continued fighting===
{{Quote|Maybe Palpatine will have to start recruiting citizens.''"<br />"''I'd rather work shorthanded than have to serve with mongrels. You've seen what they're like as fleet officers. You want them as infantry?''"<br />"''At least the war would be over quicker. We'd win or lose horribly.''"<br />"''True. Brutal, but true.|Scorch and Sev|<ref name="O66" />}}
[[File:SevBossFixer.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Sev, with Boss and Fixer]]
Seven hundred and thirty-six days after the Battle of Geonosis—on the second anniversary of the start of the Clone Wars—Delta Squad was stationed at [[Arca Company Barracks]] on Coruscant awaiting assignment. There, while Sev partook of some [[Spice/Legends|spiced]] [[warra nut]]s, Scorch discreetly spied on a meeting of ''Cuy'val Dar'' sergeants Kal Skirata and Walon Vau on the [[Barracks/Legends|barracks]] parade ground. Though Sev was initially uninterested—preferring to instead discuss Ko Sai and the possible accelerated aging cure Skirata was after for the clones—he soon joined Scorch and found the two Mandalorians were engaged in reciting the names of fallen clone commandos in the Mandalorian custom for honoring dead comrades and loved ones. Both Sev and Scorch joined the two sergeants in the commemoration ritual, along with a number of other commandos who joined in as the list of names went on. When they reached the list's end, Skirata took the time to say a few encouraging words to the assembled soldiers, and wished them all to stay safe so that they might be able to see his [[Venku Skirata|young grandson]] grow up. As the crowd dispersed, Sev turned his attention toward calibrating his helmet's [[Heads-up display/Legends|HUD]], although Scorch kept an eye on his former training sergeant long enough to see Vau and Skirata meeting with fellow former Mandalorian ''Cuy'val Dar'' trainers [[Mij Gilamar]] and [[Wad'e Tay'haai]] for reasons unknown to the two commandos.<ref name="O66" />

Several months later, approximately nine hundred and seventy days into the war, Delta Squad found themselves on the Separatist-aligned [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] planet of [[Haurgab]]. Originally, while Jedi General [[Mlaske]] and the Grand Army's [[85th Infantry Brigade]] were already [[Battle of Haurgab|operating]] on Haurgab, the only Republic commando presence on the dusty backwater world had been Omega Squad, sent to assassinate a [[Jolluc|key leader]] of the pro-Separatist [[Maujasi]]. However, as time passed, the Republic began to assign more and more Grand Army forces to Haurgab, and Delta Squad, much to their displeasure, soon became among them. Sev and the other three members of Delta Squad joined a number of other clone troops in the mess hall of the [[Hadde Base|Republic's base]] on the outskirts of the Haurgab city of [[Hadde]], during a field visit from [[Commando Group]] [[Zero Five Commando]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]], General Etain Tur-Mukan. While Delta was sitting down at a table with their food, the base was struck by a [[Huntmaster missile|missile]] from within the city limits; though numerous troopers were killed and wounded in the attack both from the blast and the resultant shrapnel, Delta Squad had been spared the worst injuries thanks to their hardy ''Katarn'' armor—without his helmet on, Sev incurred a bloodied face from flying debris. Their Omega Squad compatriots survived without injury as well, and together the two commando squads led the counterattack on the rebel forces, along with them General Tur-Mukan and elements of the 85th and [[14th Infantry Brigade]]s. When they arrived at the house from which the missile had originated, Omega and Scorch [[Breaching grenade|breached]] the door and assaulted the home, killing three rebels and capturing four others while Sev, Boss, and Fixer stood outside as security.<ref name="O66" />

===Kashyyyk===
{{Dialogue|Sev|Boss, I've got a problem here...|Boss|Sev, where are you?|Sev|Sector...multiple hostiles...|Fixer|Lost his signal, Boss.|Boss|Well, find it again, damn it! Delta, regroup. We're going after Sev.|Forward Air Controller|Negative negative, Three-Eight, new orders came through from the generals&mdash;clear the area and evac now.|attr=Sev loses contact under fire, and Delta Squad is ordered to leave without him|src=<ref name="O66" />}}
[[File:LAATiDeltaSquad-RC.png|thumb|left|250px|Delta Squad inserting on Kashyyyk]]
Around one thousand and seventy days after the Battle of Geonosis, Delta Squad was sent to the Wookiee homeworld of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] in the [[Mytaranor sector/Legends|Mytaranor sector]]. Following a Separatist-backed invasion by Trandoshan slavers, the Wookiee [[Chief/Legends|chieftain]] [[Tarfful/Legends|Tarfful]] had been taken prisoner. Tarfful had spent years combating Trandoshan slaving parties, and without him the Wookiees turned to the Republic for assistance. In response, Delta Squad was [[Mission to Kashyyyk (Clone Wars)|deployed]] to Kashyyyk in order to extract Tarfful from captivity. Sev and the rest of Delta Squad covertly inserted into Kashyyyk via LAAT/i gunship, [[Rappel line|rappelling]] down to the planet's surface from the troop bay. Battling their way through the Trandoshan slaver camp, Delta freed a number of other Wookiee captives before rescuing Tarfful from the clutches of General Grievous himself. Defeating two of the general's [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]], Delta Squad's assault prompted Grievous to flee Kashyyyk aboard his personal starfighter.<ref name="RepCom" />

Sev and Delta Squad destroyed another Trandoshan encampment not long after, before moving on the [[Kachirho Bridge|bridge]] near the Wookiee village of [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]].<ref name="RepCom" /> By this point, Delta had been joined by Jedi General Etain Tur-Mukan on order of General Arligan Zey of [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]]. She informed the squad of the bridge's significance—were the bridge to be destroyed, the Separatist supply lines would be cut off, while the Wookiees would be able to construct smaller bridges to circumvent the loss, an option the Confederacy's battle droids didn't have—and tasked the squad with taking it out.<ref name="O66" /> After battling another advanced spider droid and countless battle droids atop the [[Kachirho Bridge]]<ref name="RepCom" />—Sev making a point to stop and pick off as many Geonosians as he could, all the while<ref name="O66" />—Delta Squad placed a [[detonation pack]] at the center of the bridge, where it was weakest. However, when Boss attempted to detonate the charge, the explosives misfired.<ref name="RepCom" /> Undeterred, Scorch borrowed a [[Wookiee Guided Rocket Launcher|rocket launcher]] from a female Wookiee, and used it to destroy the bridge.<ref name="O66" />

Thirteen days later, Delta continued operations on Kashyyyk, even as Coruscant came [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|under attack]] by General Grievous. While preparing to ambush a Separatist droid patrol, Sev and Scorch listened in to the comlink traffic from Coruscant, learning that only commandos in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] had received the [[Code Five]] signal to return to Coruscant immediately. When General Tur-Mukan expressed her concern for her loved ones residing on the Republic's besieged capital, Delta Squad took it upon themselves to comfort her, and when she revealed that she had a [[Venku Skirata|son]], they promised to keep her secret. She also inquired whether the squad thought the droids they were fighting were [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]], to which Sev replied that he did, but he killed them because they were trying to kill him. Though the battle-droid patrol fell victim to Wookiee-make pitfalls, Sev and Tur-Mukan led Delta's ambush of a small group of Trandoshans scouting through the [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|Wroshyr trees]], disposing of their dead bodies via a carnivorous plant.<ref name="O66" />

[[File:SevInAction.png|thumb|right|250px|Sev in action on Kashyyyk]]
Five days later, with the crisis on Coruscant over, Delta Squad was joined on Kashyyyk by the clone forces of Jedi General [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]], arriving from [[Boz Pity/Legends|Boz Pity]]. In addition, General Yoda was inbound with the [[41st Stormtrooper Legion|41st Elite Legion]] and Wookiee Chieftain Tarfful, set to land within thirty standard minutes. However, a [[Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|''Recusant''-class light destroyer]] had taken up position to engage Yoda's [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] and halt the debarking of additional ground [[Troop/Legends|troops]]. With a bit of good-natured coaxing from General Tur-Mukan, Delta Squad infiltrated a Separatist turbolaser battery complex with the intent to commandeer the contained firepower to take out the ''Recusant''-class [[Destroyer/Legends|destroyer]]. With Clone Commander [[Gree (clone trooper)/Legends|Gree]] considering alternative landing sites—each too far removed from the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|main offensive]] to be effective—Delta Squad captured one [[Wookiee dual missile turret]] for each commando, and opened fire on the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] destroyer, joined in the attack by a [[Fighter wing/Legends|wing]] of General Vos' LAAT/i gunships. After sustaining heavy damage, the ''Recusant'' destroyer began to fall, but while the majority of Delta Squad planned for a hasty exit, Sev radioed in with a report of coming under attack from multiple hostiles. When Boss ordered the squad to go back for Sev, Vos' [[Forward Air Controller/Legends|Forward Air Controller]] instead ordered Delta to leave, stating that the order had come directly from General Yoda himself. Though Scorch argued to the point of tears, Boss forced him to comply and moved the remaining three members of Delta Squad onto the gunship that had arrived to extract them, but not without first making a guilty apology to Sev.<ref name="O66" />

===Aftermath===
In the wake of Sev's abandonment in the battery complex, he was listed as missing in action. The remaining three members of Delta Squad were wracked with guilt over being forced to leave him behind,<ref name="O66" /> and once they joined the new [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] following the [[Declaration of a New Order|transformation]] of the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the squad was given a replacement member whom Scorch insisted on viewing as only a ''temporary'' replacement.<ref name="ImpCom501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref> The clone commandos of [[Yayax Squad]] were disgusted by Delta's abandonment of Sev, while Omega Squad's members considered volunteering to search for their missing comrade. General Tur-Mukan was angered that Sev had been left behind, when previously in the war [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC troopers]] had [[Battle of Hypori/Legends|been sent]] to extract Jedi officers from danger. When news reached [[Walon Vau]], Sev's former training sergeant took it upon himself to journey to Kashyyyk in an attempt to locate the missing commando,<ref name="O66" /> but was unsuccessful in his search.<ref name="ImpCom501st" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Any sign of what killed him, Scorch?''"<br />"''Let's ask Sev. He's a dead-body-ologist.|Bardan Jusik and Scorch, after finding a humanoid skeleton|<ref name="TC" />}}
[[File:DS_Sev.png|thumb|left|180px|Sev, adorned in his personalized suit of commando armor]]
Sev was a master sniper<ref name="RepCom" /> and a fierce fighter who enjoyed the thrill of combat.<ref name="TCSWE" /> He decorated his armor with [[Blood/Legends|blood]]-[[Color/Legends|red]] markings; some had trouble distinguishing whether it was paint he had used, or real blood. Sev possessed a grim sense of humor and a powerful drive to succeed, believing that any failure of his would be letting down his training sergeant, Walon Vau, and disappointing him. Though he deeply respected and revered Vau, Sev also felt a sense of jealously toward the commandos who had been trained by Kal Skirata, who treated his trainees as though they were his sons.<ref name="TZ" /> Sev masked these inner insecurities beneath an outward personality of aggressive strength that led the rest of Delta Squad to tease that Sev was a bit of a [[Psychopathy|psychopath]], even joking that his [[cloning tank]] had been spiked during gestation—Vau even suggested the Kaminoans recheck his [[DNA/Legends|DNA]] for mental aberrations.<ref name="RepCom" />

Sev maintained a close relationship with his squadmate Scorch, trading jokes and quips with him almost constantly.<ref name="RepCom" /> He also had a close friendship with Boss, having great respect for him as a squad leader and someone he could trust. Sev found the Wookiees' tendency to blend their technology with the surrounding nature to be strange, though his time on Kashyyyk near the end of the war gave him an interest in acquiring a Wookiee [[Bandolier/Legends|bandoleer]].<ref name="RepCom" /> He enjoyed warra nuts, though the spiced kind gave him gas if he ate too many—a fact Scorch would tease him about. Sev also intensely hated Geonosians, and kept a count of Geonosian kills as a means of avenging the large number of clone commando deaths in the Battle of Geonosis: he intended to kill specifically 4,982 Geonosians, one for every fallen commando.<ref name="O66" /> However, he harbored an even stronger hatred for the Trandoshans, due to their raid on the Prosecutor and killing of his fellow clones as well their attempt to interrogate him and the rest of the squad.

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Sorry, but I can't take Sev beyond the end of his story arc in the RepCom game. His fate won't feature in IMPERIAL COMMANDO: 501st or any other book for the foreseeable future. [...] Sev is LucasArts' character, and—very sensibly—they want to leave their options open for the future, in case they ever do another game featuring Delta Squad. [...] So I can't take Sev's story beyond the end of the game, where he's still MIA. That's all there is to it. I've gone as far as I can with him, and I'll miss him, just like you will.|Karen Traviss|<ref name="sev">{{WebCite|url=http://www.karentraviss.com/html/sev.htm|archivedate=20100107231659|author=Karen Traviss|text=sev|nolive=1}}</ref>}}
RC-1207—Sev—made his first appearance in the [[2005]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando]]'', where he was voiced by [[Actor/Legends|actor]] [[Jonathan Cook]]. Sev went on to feature in the [[Republic Commando]] of novels, appearing in ''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]'', [[Republic Commando: True Colors|''True Colors'']] and [[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel|''Order 66'']], all written by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]]. Traviss also gave Sev a number of brief mentions in the series' fifth novel, ''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''. Though she indicated a desire to further his story—a desire shared by a number of fans—Sev originated in a [[LucasArts]] game and thus was withheld so that should there ever be another game featuring Delta Squad, the company would not be bound by a story Traviss had written. [[Brett Douville]], engineering lead for the Republic Commando game, has also indicated that a sequel was planned involving Sev, and that he would be intricately involved in starting the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]].
